ns2:section.sectionText: Poverty, Chronicle Health & Disability: The course will focuses on the bi-directional interaction between disability and poverty. Specifically, this course will provide a venue for students to explore how low income status and living in poverty interact with individual, social, cultural and economic factors to impact chronic physical, mental, emotional, and behavioral health and disability (PMEB).
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Freshman class standing.
